definitions.gloss: -form; the form of a word in grammar
definitions.explanation: Attached to a grammatical term to name a specific inflected or conjugated form of a word, as in {過去形|かこけい} (past-tense form) or {受身形|うけみけい} (passive form). This is the on'yomi reading of {形|かたち}.

definitions.gloss: shape, figure (in names of geometric figures)
definitions.explanation: Forms the names of geometric figures and shapes: {三角形|さんかくけい} (triangle), {四角形|しかくけい} (quadrilateral), {長方形|ちょうほうけい} (rectangle), {正方形|せいほうけい} (square), {円形|えんけい} (circular shape). It occurs only inside such compounds, never as a word on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去形|かこけい}→過去形：23881_kakokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受身形|うけみけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}で→何で：03875_nande⟧す⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the passive form of this verb?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{丁寧形|ていねいけい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{普通形|ふつうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese grammar, you need to distinguish between using the polite form and the plain form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: Prepare a square sheet of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{円形|えんけい}→円形：11674_enkei⟧だ。
examples.english: This table isn't rectangular; it's round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{六角形|ろっかくけい}→六角形：28900_rokkakukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{蜂|はち}の{巣|す}→蜂の巣：24336_hachinosu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: A honeycomb, with its rows of hexagonal cells, is known as a shape that wastes no space.

notes:
{形|けい} is the on'yomi reading of ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (shape, form), used as a suffix in two kinds of compound: grammar terms that name an inflected form of a word (sense 1), and the names of geometric figures (sense 2).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{過去形|かこけい}→過去形：23881_kakokei⟧: past-tense form
- {受身形|うけみけい}: passive form
- {丁寧形|ていねいけい}: polite (ます) form
- {普通形|ふつうけい}: plain (dictionary) form
- {可能形|かのうけい}: potential form
- て{形|けい}: te-form
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle
- ⟦{四角形|しかくけい}→四角形：05437_shikakukei⟧: quadrilateral
- ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧: rectangle
- ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧: square
- ⟦{円形|えんけい}→円形：11674_enkei⟧: circular shape

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse this reading with ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ ("shape, form"), the everyday word for the shape of an object. {形|けい} appears only attached to a preceding element, never alone as a standalone noun the way ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ can be: "a square shape" is ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧ or ⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧.
